Outblight

Download Now



Outbligh is turn-based roguelite with clash battle system
inspired  by Library of ruina and Limbus Company games.
Each skill clashes with an enemy skill by
rolling a number based on its type.

The interaction between different types of skills leads to different results.
Some skills can trigger special animation of final blow


This is post-jam version of the game
Jam version here

The world is on the brink of falling into the abyss.
The chains that have held it together for centuries are beginning
to crumble, and Abyss Holes are appearing across the world.
From them, terrifying creatures emerge, destroying everything in their path.

The Order, an organization created by an alliance of Royal Houses,
was created to combat the looming threat.

Megurt - Lead, Programmer, GD, VFX
Sakotach - Character/UI Artist
Amaryllis - Background Artist
catagen - BGM
Gebishi - Live2D animations
